name: team-ai-toolkit
description: Proof of concept: plug-and-play AI dev tooling (linters, hooks, skills) for our engineers

plugins.name: python-lint
plugins.description: Formats and lints Python with Ruff every time Claude edits a .py file

plugins.name: typescript-lint
plugins.description: Runs Prettier and ESLint every time Claude edits a TypeScript or JavaScript file

plugins.name: rust-lint
plugins.description: Runs rustfmt on every Rust file Claude edits, and clippy before Claude finishes

plugins.name: git-guardrails
plugins.description: Stops agents from skipping git hooks, force-pushing to protected branches, or weakening linter configs

plugins.name: commit-approval
plugins.description: Shows a summary of every commit Claude is about to make and asks a human to approve it

plugins.name: team-standards
plugins.description: Our style guide as a skill, plus a skill that sets up shared pre-commit hooks in any repo
